stem: What happens next in this passage after “Later, many discovered new interests.”?
options: It was also about people trying to live through difficult times.
A boy who loved swimming found that he also liked chess.
They liked the food, but they also liked knowing that nothing was wasted.
Students liked the clock because it made them feel less late.
